value.rationale: The central quotient of the first nontrivial four-dimensional hypercube Rips sphere-wedge is a natural geometric invariant. The complete integral homotopy type discovers a projective three-space summand, π1=C2, a nonzero cubic mod-two cup product, first homology Z/2 and four additional three-spheres. These topological features cannot be recovered from the published nonequivariant wedge or rational homology character and motivate the precise quotient computation.
